## 2010

Octopus starts as a spare time, nights-and-weekends hobby project for Paul while living in London, inspired by the challenges he sees implementing Agile as a contractor. He shares the first beta editions on his blog. Interest grows quickly.

![paul stovell illustrated octopus history 2010](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/850x500/db90161e98/history-octopus-2010.png)

## 2012

Paul relocates back to Brisbane and proposes to Sonia. Octopus Deploy Pty. Ltd. is incorporated in Brisbane, Australia, as Sonia and Paul turn it into a real business to work for themselves. They launch **Octopus 1.0**.

![tweet Paul Stovell history octopus 2012](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/850x500/c3d1041950/history-octopus-2012.png)

## 2014

Octopus brings on its first full-time employee - who is still with us today! Redgate Software decides to retire its database deployment tool and invests in Octopus instead, taking a minority stake. The funds from this investment are never used, as Octopus continues to be profitable and bootstrap its own growth. Octopus passes USD $1M in ARR, and opens its first office in the Brisbane CBD.

![office doors history octopus 2014](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/850x500/5df72c231c/history-octopus-2014.png)

## 2016

Octopus 3.4 ships with [tenanted deployment capabilities](https://octopus.com/use-case/tenanted-deployments). Octopus passes **$5M in ARR with 22 people**.

![meeting room 6 people history octopus 2016](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/850x500/dd6cdd76eb/history-octopus-2016.png)

## 2018

Octopus **[Cloud](https://octopus.com/docs/octopus-cloud) 1.0 launches** on top of AWS as an MVP to test demand. We switch from X.Y release numbering to using the year/release number format. Octopus 2018.8 introduces [Kubernetes and Docker support](https://octopus.com/use-case/container-deployments). Octopus reaches **$10M in ARR**. We hire our first US and UK employees and end the year with **45 people**.

![team group photo history of octopus 2018](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/850x500/e94902165b/history-octopus-2018.png)

## 2020

We introduce **[Runbook automation](https://octopus.com/docs/runbooks)** into Octopus. This makes Octopus the first CD tool that can also be naturally used for day 2 automation and bring Dev & Ops together. Octopus now employs **79 people**. We surpass **$20M ARR** and remain a profitable company.

![group photo team large history of octopus 2020](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/850x500/eb3edb918d/history-octopus-2020.png)

## 2022

Octopus ships **[Config as Code](https://octopus.com/docs/projects/version-control) support** with a groundbreaking design that lets users switch seamlessly between a UI and code, where most DevOps tools make it a one-way door. We also ship [DORA metrics](https://octopus.com/docs/insights) and several new [GitHub Actions integrations](https://octopus.com/github). We surpass **$30M in ARR**.

![buikdkite integration connecting with history of octopus 2022](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/850x500/709de7d506/history-octopus-2022.png)

## 2024

Octopus acquires Codefresh in February. Codefresh is a leader in Kubernetes CD, GitOps, and CI. Codefresh GitOps is built on top of the popular open-source Argo project, and Codefresh is a maintainer of Argo and the foremost expert in operating Argo at enterprise scale.

![Codefresh <> Octopus Deploy aquisition](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/850x500/5c7e2719d4/octopusdeploy-codefresh.png)

![empty grid col](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/92x102/eacf4f5575/empty-icon.svg)

![empty grid col](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/92x102/eacf4f5575/empty-icon.svg)

## 2011

Paul sells the first couple of **license keys**. He uses the money to reinvest back into the product and take a day or two off from his full-time contracting job. Redgate Software licenses the Octopus source code to build a database-focused deployment tool.

![concept webpage octopus history 2011](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/850x500/f4ba61644b/history-octopus-2011.png)

## 2013

Octopus brings on its first couple of employees as contractors. Octopus is still fully bootstrapped at this point. **Octopus 2.0** launches.

![tweet Paul Stovell history octopus 2013](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/850x500/33f2884327/history-octopus-2013.png)

## 2015

Octopus is now **13 people**. Octopus 3.0 launches with [High Availability](https://octopus.com/docs/administration/high-availability) support and a huge architectural overhaul to better suit [enterprise deployments](https://octopus.com/enterprise).

![video call meeting history octopus 2015](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/850x500/6158edcac3/history-octopus-2015.png)

## 2017

Octopus 4.0 ships with a UI overhaul.

![needle in a haystack tentacles 4.0 release history octopus 2015](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/850x500/f8cabf7187/history-octopus-2017.png)

## 2019

We introduce [Spaces](https://octopus.com/docs/administration/spaces) and [deploying to Linux agents](https://octopus.com/docs/infrastructure/deployment-targets/linux), and work item tracking with [Jira integration](https://octopus.com/docs/releases/issue-tracking/jira). Octopus **Cloud 2.0 is rebuilt on top of Azure and Kubernetes**.

![ship kubernetes clouds history of octopus 2019](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/850x500/8048ffb78e/history-octopus-2019.png)

## 2021

Insight Partners **[invests $172.5M](https://octopus.com/blog/insight-investment)** in Octopus Deploy. At the time, it's the second-largest growth investment into an Australian software company ever. **[We acquire Dist](https://octopus.com/blog/octopus-acquires-dist)**. We end the year with **168 people**.

![2021history octopus insight partners illustration](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/850x500/56af0043fc/2021history-octopus.svg)

## 2023

We ship a host of **[Kubernetes improvements](https://octopus.com/whatsnew)** including showing the object status during a deployment. We focus heavily on ensuring the software and our Cloud platform scale well with our increasingly large enterprise customers. Octopus surpasses **$50M in revenue** and 3,700 customers, and has over **200 employees**.

![seven people conference photo history of octopus 2023](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/850x500/01abf9d43e/history-octopus-2023.png)

## Fun facts we're proud of

In all our years of operating, we've:

- Always been a remote-first company
- Only had one year in which we didn't turn a cash profit
- Never created a pitch deck
- Never been sued, had an unfair dismissal claim, or other employment legal dispute

### CNCF

We are a member of the Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF), which supports projects for critical components of global technology infrastructure.

[Learn more](https://cncf.io/)

![cd foundation logo](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/462x338/fdd346d667/cd-foundation.png/m/fit-in/1200x0/filters:quality(85):format(webp))

### CD Foundation

As a member of the Continuous Delivery Foundation, we support the growth and evolution of Continuous Delivery models and best practices, along with CDF projects like Jenkins, Spinnaker, and Tekton.

[Learn more](https://cd.foundation/)

![linux foundation 2 woman](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/462x338/1794caac3e/linux-foundation.png/m/fit-in/1200x0/filters:quality(85):format(webp))

### Linux Foundation

Through the Linux Foundation, we support projects like Linux, Node.js, and other mission-critical projects that form the backbone of the modern internet.

[Learn more](https://www.linuxfoundation.org/)
